newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WMC studying nickel smelter force majeure.
newsitem.headline: WMC studying nickel smelter force majeure.

text.p: Australian mining house WMC Ltd said on Tuesday that it was considering force majeure on some nickel sales due to the temporary closure of its Kalgoorlie smelter in Western Australia.
"It (force majeure) is certainly an issue we are looking at but on what terms and with whom we would prefer not to comment," a WMC spokesman said.
WMC said on Monday that the smelter operations would be suspended for about 30 days following the collapse of part of a furnace roof on the weekend.
The spokesman said this shutdown would reduce annualised nickel matte production by 7-8,000 tonnes.
Planned maintenance work set for May and October would be brought forward to the current period, allowing an annualised net production loss of an estimated 3,000 tonnes, he said.
